plan.title: Liver 3-group DESeq2 LRT + pairwise DE and pathway enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: Design: 3 groups (control, treated_a, treated_b), 4 replicates each, unpaired, single batch, raw gene-level counts from Salmon (12000 genes x 12 samples, taxon 9606, liver). The research question has two parts: (1) which genes differ across the three groups at all (an any-difference / omnibus question), and (2) which genes each treatment changes relative to control (pairwise contrasts). This maps directly to the DESeq2 likelihood-ratio-test (LRT) design for question 1 (full ~condition vs reduced ~1) and pairwise Wald contrasts (treated_a vs control, treated_b vs control) for question 2, per the sourced procedure (R-0059). Counts are delivered as a gene-level table from Salmon with no accompanying quantification files or average-transcript-length table, so the import state is 'unknown' — the length correction cannot be verified (R-0169); the model is fit on the counts as delivered with no length offset, and this caveat is carried into the DE step and the report. QC precedes modeling to check sample structure (PCA, sample-distance heatmap) before any test runs. A minimal count pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=4 samples, the smallest group size) precedes normalization, which is internal to DESeq2 (median-of-ratios), never a manual pre-normalization. LFC is shrunk with ashr (required for multi-coefficient contrasts, unlike apeglm which needs a single coefficient). BH-adjusted p-values with DESeq2's independent filtering give per-contrast significance at alpha 0.05, reported per contrast (not pooled). Two enrichment steps follow: fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic per contrast (LRT gene set, and per pairwise contrast) against MSigDB Hallmark (2026.1, staged), then Reactome (current, staged) and WikiPathways (2026.07.10, staged) as the second and further collections. A final report integrates DE tables, diagnostic plots (MA, dispersion, p-value histograms), enrichment tables with leading-edge genes, and a full reproducibility record (session info, package versions, gene-set collection versions, random seeds). A knowledge-service check flagged that the QC step's method wording must exactly match the sourced method name ('Sample structure QC: vst(blind), PCA, sample distances, library sizes') and that the pre-filter step must be a distinct step from BH/independent filtering (they were mistakenly merged in an earlier draft) — both are corrected in this plan.

flags.message: A quantifier name alone does not establish that the length correction occurred. If the counts come from Salmon, kallisto, or RSEM as a gene-level table, with no per-sample quantification files and no average transcript length table, the import state is not established. Ask for the per-sample quantification files, quant.sf, abundance.h5, or genes.results, or for the average transcript length table per gene and sample. If neither arrives, fit the count model on the counts as delivered, with no length offset, and state in the plan and in the report that the length offset is lost and that a change in isoform use can show as differential expression. Do not run tximport on a gene table, because tximport imports transcript estimates, and do not invent a length input.

If fewer than about 50 genes pass the significance threshold, do not run an over-representation test on that list. A hypergeometric test of a short list finds no category, and a change of the threshold changes the list and the result. Run the ranked method on the full list of tested genes instead, because it finds a set of genes with a small but coordinated change that no single gene shows. State the size of the significant list in the report.

steps.method: DESeq2 blind VST + PCA + sample distance heatmap
minimal pre-filter then independent filtering
DESeq2 design ~condition, explicit reference level control, named contrasts
DESeq2 likelihood ratio test (full ~condition vs reduced ~1) then pairwise Wald contrasts vs control
ashr shrinkage of contrast log2FoldChange
Benjamini-Hochberg within each contrast, independent filtering, alpha 0.05
fgsea preranked GSEA per contrast on Wald statistic, Hallmark then Reactome and WikiPathways
integrated DE + enrichment report with diagnostics and reproducibility record
